block-guide:
CORE/SITE-LOGO (Site Logo) Draws the site's logo image, linked to the home page by default. The image is a site setting (the custom logo), not part of the block: one logo for every site-logo block on the site. These tools do not set it (update-site-settings sets the favicon, siteIcon, not the logo). A person sets it in the WordPress editor, with the block's own upload button. Places: a header or footer global block, or a template frame.
MARKUP (comment only; no HTML) <!-- wp:site-logo {"width":120} /--> <!-- wp:site-logo {"width":48,"isLink":false} /--> width: pixels; the height follows the image's proportions. isLink (default true) links to the home page; linkTarget "_blank" opens a new tab.
PITFALLS - With no logo set the block draws NOTHING on the page (no wrapper, no placeholder): open the page to see whether a logo is set. When there is none, use core/site-title, or core/image with an uploaded logo file (a fixed image, not the site setting).
CHECK Open any page: the logo appears at the chosen width and links home.
